correctness.rationale: Character orthogonality turns the fourth moment into exact pair-sum energy. Mixed coarse residues have two oriented representations by Hensel lifting; same-class pairs split into p² blocks with convolution over F_p. Parseval gives E_r=p⁻¹ Σ_ξ(2S_r(ξ)²−Σ_u A_{r,u}(ξ)²). Rearrangement against (2p−1)m_r² produces three explicitly nonnegative terms; equality forces one parent residue, one fine frequency, and uniform block energies, hence the entire p²-torus family. Independently enumerated all Z/27Z pair fibers on complex Gaussian-integer inputs and matched the spectral deficit against the direct convolution defect. No numerical experiment is used as the all-odd-p proof.
